subject.title: fix: prevent operational notices from leaking to source chats

question: Should `messages.operationalReplies.redirect` remain fail-closed when writing the operator session fails, or should OpenClaw define a retry/recovery contract before exposing this setting?
rationale: The choice controls whether potentially sensitive runtime text can reappear in the source chat versus whether an operator may lose visibility of a failed redirect; neither outcome is a mechanical correctness decision.

options.title: Approve fail-closed redirect
options.body: Keep the submitted behavior: suppress the source notice when the operator-session write fails, and document that the operator destination must be reliable.

options.title: Define retry semantics
options.body: Require a bounded retry or durable recovery path that preserves source suppression while giving operators a way to recover failed redirects.

options.title: Defer redirect mode
options.body: Land only non-redirect modes later or keep the entire feature open until the owner contract is decided.

recommendation.title: Approve fail-closed redirect
recommendation.body: Keep the submitted behavior: suppress the source notice when the operator-session write fails, and document that the operator destination must be reliable.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the available technical contact with the full implementation and evidence context; an OpenClaw security/product owner should make the final policy choice.
